title: Watering the Beans

readiness.math: counting to 2 for each plant; one-to-one correspondence
readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: The sun has been hot, and our bean plants are thirsty. Look how they droop.

intro.speaker: miriam
intro.text: Each plant needs two drops from the watering can. Not too little, and not too much.

steps.speaker: miriam
steps.prompt: Give each bean plant two drops of water. Put one drop on each dot.
steps.hint: Find a plant with an empty dot, and put a drop there.

feedback.full: That plant has had its two drops. Try a plant that still looks thirsty.
feedback.all_good: Two, two, two, two. Every plant has had a drink.

outro.speaker: miriam
outro.text: Look! They're standing up tall again. Tomorrow, they'll be even stronger.

journal_line: I watered the bean plants with Miriam: two drops for each plant.
unavailable_text: The beans have had their water today. They'll be thirsty again tomorrow.
